response.rationale: The vignette describes a patient with brownish macules on the hands and feet, onychodystrophy, multiple type II and III Yamada polyps on atrophic gastric mucosa, and numerous sessile and subpedunculated polyps throughout the colon and rectum. These findings are all directly supported by Peutz-Jeghers Syndrome (D6). Other candidates have contradictory findings or fewer direct supports.
